file: 05- Fraud Detection and Prevention for the Insurance I.docx
title: Fraud Detection and Prevention for the Insurance Industry
overview: This course is designed to equip professionals in the insurance industry with the skills and tools to prevent, detect, investigate, and prosecute fraud. Participants will learn to protect their organizations from internal threats such as agent/broker premium diversion, reinsurance fraud, and rented asset schemes, as well as external threats like staged auto accidents, fake insurance companies, offshore/unlicensed internet companies, and settlement fraud.
audience: This course is ideal for auditors, investigators, and prosecutors working in the insurance fraud domain. It is also suitable for professionals seeking to expand their expertise in fraud detection and prevention.
methodology: The program incorporates a combination of presentations, discussions, case studies, videos, role-plays, and interactive exercises to bridge theoretical knowledge with practical application.
competencies: Fraud prevention and detection in insurance
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand the role of ethics in preventing insurance fraud.
Recognize the various types and nature of insurance fraud.
Establish fraud prevention strategies for their organization.
Implement effective anti-fraud measures and manage fraud-related risks.
Conduct investigations and prepare legal cases for prosecuting suspected fraudsters.
